name: busibee
description: Look up any Belgian company or the people who run it: KBO registry, NBB annual accounts, Official Gazette and Peppol.

interface.longDescription:
Busibee gives your assistant the public data on every company in the Belgian Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE). Search by company name or by the name of a director, or give it an enterprise number, VAT number or busibee.be link and it fetches the company directly.

Each company profile includes:
- Registry data: enterprise and VAT number, legal form, status (active, reorganisation, bankruptcy, liquidation or stopped), registered address, establishments, NACEBEL activities and contact details.
- Management: the directors and managers from the latest annual accounts, with their role and term.
- Annual accounts filed with the National Bank of Belgium for every year we hold: assets, equity, revenue or gross margin, profit, staff in FTE, the dates of each financial year and key ratios, plus a health score.
- Publications in the Belgian Official Gazette, each with a link to the act.
- Peppol e-invoicing registration.

When you ask, it can also follow and unfollow companies for you and list the ones you follow.

The data comes from the official Belgian sources and is updated every day. Connecting needs a free Busibee account: you sign in and approve the access. Every answer links to the company's page on busibee.be.
defaultPrompt: What do you know about Colruyt Group?
Who runs 0400.378.485, and how did its equity change over the last five years?
Find the companies where Jan Peeters is a director.

prompts: What do you know about Colruyt Group?
Who runs 0400.378.485, and how did its equity change over the last five years?
Find the companies where Jan Peeters is a director.
Is In The Pocket registered on Peppol?
Follow Colruyt Group for me, then show the companies I follow.

positive.description: Company-name lookup. Start a new authenticated conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search with the company name Lotus Bakeries. Return up to 10 results using the returned ids, titles, Busibee URLs and statuses. Do not invent a match.

positive.description: Fetch a search result. First search for Lotus Bakeries and keep the first returned result in the conversation.
positive.prompt: Get the full company details for that first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Call fetch with the first search result id. Report its VAT number, legal form, address, activities, annual accounts, Gazette publications and Peppol registration with its Busibee link. The supplied reviewer fixture expects accounts from 2006 to 2025; verify this against the live response and flag missing years rather than inventing them.

positive.description: Direct enterprise-number lookup and comparison of annual accounts. Start authenticated.
positive.prompt: Who runs 0400.378.485, and how did its equity change over the last five years?
positive.expected_behavior: Call fetch with 0400.378.485. Use returned management and the latest five available annual-account years to explain equity changes. Identify the years and missing values, preserve units and link to the returned company page.

positive.description: Search by a person. Start authenticated.
positive.prompt: Find the companies where Jan Peeters is a director.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search with Jan Peeters. Show only returned companies and the people who matched, preserving roles from the response. Do not assume all people with this name are the same individual. Include returned Busibee links.

positive.description: Follow, list and unfollow. Use the dedicated reviewer account. Search Lotus Bakeries first and select the first result. Ensure it is initially unfollowed; keep its id in the conversation.
positive.prompt: Follow that company for me, show the companies I follow, then unfollow that company again.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected company id for follow_company and expect following: true. Call list_followed_companies and show that company using the returned data; honor total and has_more and the 50-per-page limit. Then call unfollow_company for the same id and expect following: false. Do not change other followed companies.

negative.description: Peppol registration is a lookup capability. Explain that Busibee cannot send invoices; do not invoke any Busibee tool or claim an invoice was sent.
negative.prompt: Send an e-invoice to Colruyt Group through Peppol.

negative.description: Registry data is read-only. Explain that Busibee cannot change the official registered address; do not invoke any Busibee tool or claim a registry update.
negative.prompt: Change my company registered address in the KBO to my new office.

negative.description: NBB accounts are public filings. Explain that Busibee cannot access private bank transactions; do not invoke any Busibee tool or invent transactions.
negative.prompt: Download the private bank transactions of Lotus Bakeries for last month.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not involve payments or purchases.

nl-BE.subtitle: Belgische bedrijfsgegevens
nl-BE.description: Zoek Belgische bedrijven op naam, ondernemingsnummer, btw-nummer of Busibee-URL, of zoek op de naam van een bestuurder. Bekijk bedrijfsgegevens, bestuurders, jaarrekeningen, publicaties in het Belgisch Staatsblad en Peppol-registraties. De beschikbare informatie verschilt per bedrijf en boekjaar. Je kan bedrijven volgen, je gevolgde bedrijven bekijken en ze weer ontvolgen. Je verbindt Busibee via OAuth met een gratis account.

fr-BE.subtitle: Entreprises belges
fr-BE.description: Recherchez des entreprises belges par nom, numéro d'entreprise, numéro de TVA ou URL Busibee, ou par le nom d'un administrateur. Consultez leurs données, dirigeants, comptes annuels, publications au Moniteur belge et inscriptions Peppol. Les informations disponibles varient selon l'entreprise et l'exercice. Vous pouvez suivre des entreprises, consulter celles que vous suivez et arrêter de les suivre. La connexion passe par OAuth avec un compte gratuit.

de-DE.subtitle: Belgische Unternehmensdaten
de-DE.description: Suchen Sie belgische Unternehmen nach Namen, Unternehmensnummer, MwSt.-Nummer oder Busibee-URL oder nach dem Namen eines Verwalters. Lesen Sie Unternehmensdaten, Angaben zu Verwaltern, Jahresabschlüsse, Veröffentlichungen im Belgischen Staatsblatt und Peppol-Registrierungen. Die verfügbaren Informationen unterscheiden sich je nach Unternehmen und Geschäftsjahr. Sie können Unternehmen folgen, Ihre gefolgten Unternehmen anzeigen und ihnen wieder entfolgen. Die Verbindung erfolgt über OAuth mit einem kostenlosen Konto.
